text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. Looking at her racewear fresh 
back from the laundry, Tamamo Cross 
muttered softly.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Huh—looking at it like this really brings 
back memories. Like the day my racing 
uniform first arrived..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ta-daaa! My racing outfit's finally here!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's the grand reveal~! Give me a 
countdown, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're so slow!! They've already 
come out!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, you really can't close the deal. 
That's just how you are, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think? I truly am the "White 
Lightning"! Super pretty and totally cool, 
right?!
choice_data_list:
That suits your image perfectly, doesn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Told ya, told ya, right~! It's totally a 
lightning bolt right through the heart!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I wanna hurry up and show this to Dad, 
Mom, and the little ones too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
To think I was allowed to attend Tracen 
Academy, and even got my own Racewear...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...The reason I can smile and give it my 
all is because those folks are watching 
over me with smiles of their own.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta wear this for my triumphant 
return home.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's keep this momentum going 
right into training!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, it's totally pourin' down out here!! 
"Talk about real lightning"—shut up 
already!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's a brand-new, best-dressed outfit, 
after all. Hmm... what should I do, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's a brand-new, best-dressed outfit, 
after all. Hmm... what should I do, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...!! Well said, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Races still happen even in heavy 
rain.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Gettin' covered in mud is a badge of 
honor! That's what racin' is all about for 
me, Tamamo Cross!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Here we go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think? Ain't I the coolest in the 
whole world right now?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
W-What's up with you? You're being nice 
out of nowhere, it's throwing me off.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, ya didn't have to worry about me. 
Though I guess gettin' covered in mud 
suits me just fine.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks, Trainer. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
When it's time to race, I'm gonna get 
these clothes totally filthy and show 
everyone how I snatch 1st place!!
